name: Fujiwara no Michimasa
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 63); Porter’s note gives the dates as: lived c. 1030.

poems.title: If we could meet in privacy
poems.author: Fujiwara no Michimasa
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 63
poems.text:
If we could meet in privacy,
Where no one else could see,
Softly I’d whisper in thy ear
This little word from me—
‘I’m dying, Love, for thee.’
